newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Nordbanken keeps rising on buy-back deal.
newsitem.headline: Nordbanken keeps rising on buy-back deal.

text.p: Swedish state-controlled bank Nordbanken continued to rise in early Thursday trade after the bank on Wednesday announced a five billion crown share buy-back.
Within 20 minutes of trade the bank's share price was five crowns higher at 154 crowns. On Wednesday it closed 13.50 crowns higher at 149 crowns.

Analysts said the share buy-back scheme was positive for the bank, as it would cut the number of shares by 15-18 percent, boost earnings per share and lift the bank's share price in preparation for a potential merger or takeover.
The government said the deal was positive as it could cut its ownership to 58 percent from 65.5 percent, paving the way for the planned denationalisation of the bank.
